target_customer: Frontier AI labs and robotics companies buying real-world demonstration and teleoperation data
problem: Robotics labs lack diverse real-world training data. Hub collects human demonstrations and robot teleoperation in real workplaces and deploys machines to produce labor output.
business_model: Data sales and robot deployment services
product_category: Physical AI data and deployment infrastructure

founders.name: Armin Kiani
founders.background_notes: YC page lists CS and robotics background and a Microsoft Innovation Award (2020); education not stated.

founders.name: Tim Sprecher
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder and COO in the September 2025 press release.

competitors.name: Scale AI
competitors.what: Data infrastructure and annotation for robotics pipelines including teleoperation data

competitors.name: Claru
competitors.what: Managed contributor network for teleoperation and human demonstrations

competitors.name: Knox Labs
competitors.what: Teleoperation and human demonstration data in real homes

technical_complexity.rationale: Coordinating a global operator network, hardware rigs and robots in the field; operations heavy more than research heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Data collection operations scale but are copyable; many funded rivals in 2026.

market_need_then: Labs are buying large amounts of human and teleoperation data for robot learning; the YC launch post reports a move from a 5-figure to a 7-figure revenue agreement (self-reported).

branding.domain_note: Uses hub.xyz, a short domain, per 2025 press releases

identity.visual_style: Minimal and technical with numbered sections and arrow calls to action

branding.community_and_virality: Not found beyond press releases; earlier SwissBorg community node tie-in

brand_strength.rationale: Clean site style but the name is generic and appears as Hub, Hub.xyz and Hub Labs.

pivots.from: Distributed AI and data infrastructure network using idle user bandwidth (Hub.xyz)
pivots.to: Real-world training data and deployment for embodied AI
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from differing descriptions in the 2025 press release versus the 2026 YC page.

outcome_analysis: Hub is an active S26 company that moved from a distributed AI data network to robotics training data, with 1.7M raised from SwissBorg by September 2025 and a self-reported 7-figure data deal in 2026. It is competing with many funded data providers; no outcome events were found.
notes: The 1.7M is the total to date after closing pre-seed and opening seed; stage not stated precisely so recorded as other. Pre-YC round (more than a month before batch). Tying Hub.xyz to the YC company relies on matching name, co-founder Tim Sprecher and the YC listing. Crunchbase page was placeholder. The pivot description is an inference from sources; the YC page gives founding year 2024. YC batch listed as Spring 2026.
